reasoning: The code divergence is exactly as claimed. ImproperSQDistHarm::compute (src/YAFF/improper_sqdistharm.cpp:98-133) computes six bond vectors and calls 'domain->minimum_image(FLERR, ...)' after each; ImproperSQDistHarmOMP does the same (src/OPENMP/improper_sqdistharm_omp.cpp:119-149). The /kk functor (improper_sqdistharm_kokkos.cpp:148-166) computes xab/xac/xad/xbc/xcd straight from x(i2,0)-x(i1,0) etc. with no wrapping at all, and 'grep minimum_image src/KOKKOS/improper_sqdistharm_kokkos.cpp' is empty. (It also drops the CPU's xbd/ybd/zbd vector, but that one is dead in the CPU too -- it is never read after its minimum_image call.) ADJUSTMENT to severity, medium -> low, on two grounds I checked. First, the wrapping is a no-op for any valid improper: NTopoImproperAll::build (src/ntopo_improper_all.cpp:69-72) runs all four atoms through domain->closest_image(i, atomN) when building the improper list, so the displacements are already minimum-image, and Domain::minimum_image only rewraps when |d| > half the box. Second, the reference implementation of the idiom in KOKKOS (BondHarmonicRestrainKokkos, bond_harmonic_restrain_kokkos.cpp:188-196) applies its device-side minimum_image only to the STORED initial positions d_x0 and deliberately not to the current-x displacement -- confirming the convention that current-position bonded displacements need no wrapping. A numerical difference therefore requires an improper spanning more than half the box, where both implementations are already unreliable. Worth fixing for exact parity with the CPU style, not urgent.
fix: For exact parity, add a KOKKOS_INLINE_FUNCTION minimum_image(dx,dy,dz) member plus the cached triclinic/xperiodic/xprd/xprd_half/... scalars, copying the pattern in src/KOKKOS/bond_harmonic_restrain_kokkos.cpp:111-120 and :243-, and call it on xab, xac, xad, xbc and xcd after each is formed. The CPU's sixth vector (xbd/ybd/zbd) is unused and should not be ported; consider deleting it from the YAFF and OPENMP styles too.
